notes.title: Update #16
notes.notes:
Added suicide option, by default it is binded to 'k' key and it may be remapped as you want in the controlls menu.
 Fixed issue related to the cheat menu, it will be unlocked too when part of campaign is completed on Extreme and rest of campaign on Insane.

Examples when cheat menu will be unlocked:


 all maps completed on Extreme difficulty
 or all maps completed on Insane difficulty
 or Home/Marina/Train/Train Station completed on Extreme and Downtown/Army Base/ Power Plant on Insane difficulty


 Added requested event: MyCharacter->OnKickDamageSomething(const TArray& DamagedActors); - it will be fired when kick damaged something.

notes.title: Mod Update #1
notes.notes:
Update Notes:
added mod support:  more information here
you asked and whined so here you go: added the possibility to change the algorithm that is used for AA. You can choose between TemporalAA and FXAA. Choose the one that suits you better in the Graphics Menu
several further performance improvements
multiple bugfixes and tweaks (I know how it sounds, but really, we did)
	
	fixed wind influence on Notim Portant's hair
	added missing localizations in several places as well as updating them in run-time while people mess in the menu
	fixed applying explosion radial damage
	low health effects are now disabled during cutscenes
	pistol and bazooka pickups should not spin infinitely anymore
	dodge gives the same advantages as crouch
	fixed cutscenes entered in car (trainstation / armybase) - the character model should be now properly rendered and positioned
	fixed burning trees/bushes that did not burn
	fixed issues with AIs burning, added little delay before start burning animation so it seems less synchronized
	fixed car collision at very low speeds vs pawns, so it is no longer possible to 'ghost ride'
	fixed disappearing rain when entering the vehicle
	fixed muted sounds in main menu if hero died and the game returned to main menu
	automatically hiding rain if hero is inside a building
	fixed weird issues in cutscenes when players 'dodge to cutscene' or 'run to cutscene'
	fixed blurry stop and speed limit signs in the main menu
	fixed appearing burned corpses when they were hidden at the upper floor of a building
	fixed bus stop windows breaking behavior - you can now destroy those windows one by one, they won't destroy each other in sequence :)
	implemented random scale of bullet tracers so they do not always look the same
	tweaked ragdolls so they look a bit better in most cases
	fixed hiding mouse cursor after panel code (Power Plant ending cutscene)
	doors can be destroyed with flamethrower much quicker now, quick enough for it to be viable
	fixed spawning decals and some destructible chunks at inappropriate places
	increased survival characters turn rate so it matches The Antagonist turn rate
	fixed an AI behavior when when the AI exited from a burning vehicle (they were getting very tough and kept shooting while screaming in agony, bad asses)
	fixed rare crash if player exited from the vehicle while shooting from turret
	fixed re-spawn problems at Downtown map near weapon exhibition when the respawn was acquired inside a SWAT truck
	restored skulls background to pause/death screen
	tweaked vehicle behavior when they explode
	fixed flamer particle without ammo
	fixed damage indicator scaling on non FHD resolutions
	fixed burning civilians dressed in white coats - the civilians burned, but their coats were resistant to fire, we gave them new ones, less OP
	while in drunk mode your movement is vastly different
	metal doors in Metro level are now properly blocking fire from a flamethrower
	got rid of insanely bright specular and lens flare effect in a certain spot and right camera angle on Power Plant level
	fixed indestructible trash cans on Home stage
	solved the issue with disappearing speakers from the boom box at the party
	fixed issues with executions when you kicked a person under a flashbang effect and performed cinematic execution straight afterwards
	fixed an issue when a weapon you picked up was unloaded and as a result removed from your inventory, happened with shotguns found in upper stage of Power Plant when going down
	adrenaline in SV no longer counts down during pause
	fixed issue with muted voice overs during the last cutscene when the 'voice volume' was set to 0
	fixed rain not raining on Marina stage after restarting the level
	kitchen oven was getting blasted so hard that it did not realize that it hit the ceiling and roof until it was already in outer space. This behavior has been corrected, and although the kitchen oven is not satisfied we consider it the way it's meant to be. Life is brutal.
	

Thing that is not a bug but might seem so:

Survival score on the end match screen will always be 0 when a mod is enabled, because ladders are blocked with any mod enabled

notes.title: Free Survival update
notes.notes:
Survival Mode:

	Several characters to choose from with varying speed and toughness
	Rank system - unlockable perks, weapons
	New leaderboards
	Added custom maps for this mode only
	Special weapons


Cheats in Advanced Gameplay Options

	Infinite ammo
	God mode
	Any weapon (including new ones)
	
   To unlock cheats you must first finish the entire game at least on 'Extreme' difficulty
   
   Cheats are allowed both in Survival mode and in campaign. Using cheats blocks all leaderboards from progressing and almost all achievements (the playtime one keeps ticking only)

   More explaining: If you start a level with cheats enabled (doable from the main menu) you will not get any progress saved for the whole play. You need to exit the level, disable cheats and start with them disabled. Using 'spawn any weapon' cheat blocks saving progress for the map where the cheat was used. If you progress through campaign to next level, the progress from the next level will be saved, although you will have default weapons for that level instead of the ones you had. 
   
   
   
Two new difficulty settings
	Story Mode:
		One additional respawn received at the level start
		You receive 2 respawns per side quest instead of one
		Player has twice the health than on 'Easy' difficulty
		Body Armor is 50% stronger
		A single execution healths to full
		Full health on respawn
	
	Insane:
		 No respawns
		 Half the health than on 'Extreme' difficulty
		 The game will no longer outline all enemies with a red border when viewing active quests
		 Radar does not show people and cars
		 Body Armor is 50% weaker
		 Rest of the rules ( e.g. health regeneration on execution ) - stays the same relative to the reduced health - you regenerate 20% health each execution just as on 'Extreme' but 20% of lowered health is much less
	
		
Hardware Cursor added in the Gameplay Options to reduce noticeable lag when frame rates are low
	
	 When you enable it, you will be unable to change crosshair color or scale - these options only work with software cursor
	 You will not see reload progress around the crosshair
	 In exchange you are able to create your custom cursors and use them in our game. Simply put properly prepared *.cur file in the Saved\Cursors catalogue
	 If you wish to create animated cursors, you can! They should be placed in the same directory as the regular ones. The supported file extension is *.ani
	 To change the hardware cursor icon change the 'Crosshair Type' option. Instead of showing our standard icons it will contain numbers. The number relates to the order in which the files are placed in the folder
	
	
New achievements:
	
	For completing the game on 'Story Mode' - this one will also unlock after beating the game on any other difficulty. To acquire it you have to finish any level on any difficulty if you have already finished the game
	For completing the game on 'Insane'
	For finishing each level on 'Insane' difficulty with all sidequests
	Survival achievements
	
	
Additional side quests for some levels - more respawns for those who need them
	
	Two for Army Base
	One for Marina
	One for Downtown
	
	

 Added the ability to play 'Truck Stop' or 'Marina' level without having to play through 'Train' or 'Sewers' respectively
 Added option to change sprint behaviour - when on, sprinting no longer requires continuous holding of the 'Run' button. To stop the character from sprinting in this mode you simply press the sprint button again or make an action that prohibits sprinting
 Both civilian and human shields health has been randomized so you will no longer '2shot everyone with pistol'
 Released Steam Cards, Emoticons & Badges
 Borderless windowed mode available in the Graphics Options
 Further performance and stability improvements
 Improved car behaviour - driving
 Multiple bugfixes
 
 
 
Known bugs:
	
	Some of the UI texts are cut at the end
	
	
Information:
Players that tested this patch prior to release suggested we allow more bodies to be lying on the map. Default is 50 and we decided to not increase it due to performance reasons. However, we've also decided to not ignore the request, therefore you can modify that value through config file, located at "Hatred\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Game.ini". Simply paste at the end of the file:
 
[/Script/Hatred.HatredSurvivalGameMode]
MaximumNumberOfRagdolls=50

You can choose how many corpses should be left alone. Keep in mind that it has an impact on performance, so make sure your PC can handle it. Survival maps are much smaller than the campaign ones, they run faster.

		Body Armor is 50% stronger
		A single execution healths to full
		Full health on respawn
	
	Insane:
		 No respawns
		 Half the health than on 'Extreme' difficulty
		 The game will no longer outline all enemies with a red border when viewing active quests
		 Radar does not show people and cars
		 Body Armor is 50% weaker
		 Rest of the rules ( e.g. health regeneration on execution ) - stays the same relative to the reduced health - you regenerate 20% health each execution just as on 'Extreme' but 20% of lowered health is much less
	
		
Hardware Cursor added in the Gameplay Options to reduce noticeable lag when frame rates are low
	
	 When you enable it, you will be unable to change crosshair color or scale - these options only work with software cursor
	 You will not see reload progress around the crosshair
	 In exchange you are able to create your custom cursors and use them in our game. Simply put properly prepared *.cur file in the Saved\Cursors catalogue
	 If you wish to create animated cursors, you can! They should be placed in the same directory as the regular ones. The supported file extension is *.ani
	 To change the hardware cursor icon change the 'Crosshair Type' option. Instead of showing our standard icons it will contain numbers. The number relates to the order in which the files are placed in the folder
	
	
New achievements:
	
	For completing the game on 'Story Mode' - this one will also unlock after beating the game on any other difficulty. To acquire it you have to finish any level on any difficulty if you have already finished the game
	For completing the game on 'Insane'
	For finishing each level on 'Insane' difficulty with all sidequests
	Survival achievements
	
	
Additional side quests for some levels - more respawns for those who need them
	
	Two for Army Base
	One for Marina
	One for Downtown
	
	

 Added the ability to play 'Truck Stop' or 'Marina' level without having to play through 'Train' or 'Sewers' respectively
 Added option to change sprint behaviour - when on, sprinting no longer requires continuous holding of the 'Run' button. To stop the character from sprinting in this mode you simply press the sprint button again or make an action that prohibits sprinting
 Both civilian and human shields health has been randomized so you will no longer '2shot everyone with pistol'
 Released Steam Cards, Emoticons & Badges
 Borderless windowed mode available in the Graphics Options
 Further performance and stability improvements
 Improved car behaviour - driving
 Multiple bugfixes
 
 
 
Known bugs:
	
	Some of the UI texts are cut at the end
	
	
Information:
Players that tested this patch prior to release suggested we allow more bodies to be lying on the map. Default is 50 and we decided to not increase it due to performance reasons. However, we've also decided to not ignore the request, therefore you can modify that value through config file, located at "Hatred\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Game.ini". Simply paste at the end of the file:
 
[/Script/Hatred.HatredSurvivalGameMode]
MaximumNumberOfRagdolls=50

You can choose how many corpses should be left alone. Keep in mind that it has an impact on performance, so make sure your PC can handle it. Survival maps are much smaller than the campaign ones, they run faster.

notes.title: Patch nr. 5
notes.notes:
- fixed some reported crashes
 - improved performance on AMD processors during heartbeat/flashbang effects
 - reduced range for soldiers in order to prevent them from shooting outside of the screen
 


 Since we're adding tons of new options in this patch, we've decided to explain what these are. I've allowed myself to quote UE4 documentation on some of those.
 
 Gameplay tab: 
 
	Crosshair scale - added 3rd option that modifies the crosshair so you have more ways to play with it to make it more visible. Changing the icon, color and scale will most certainly help you fit it to your needs.
 
 Advanced Graphics tab:
 
	Detail Mode - On lower settings cuts out certain objects and effects that are more expensive.
	
	Lens Flares - Controls the quality. When set to LOW the effect is not used and turned off. "The Lens Flare effect is an image-based technique that simulates the scattering of light when viewing bright objects due to imperfections in camera lenses."
 
	Decals - On lower settings decals exist in the world shorter. Decals are mainly blood effects on floors and walls, gunshot holes and explosions on ground.
 
	Destruction system - On LOW you can destroy only few physics meshes that affect the gameplay. On high it uses all the physics we allow. Helps mainly when you destroy half the city and it starts going slower and slower.
 
	Frame rate cap - we've received many requests about several features, this is one of them. Caps the frame rate to the value specified. Keep in mind that if you have VSync enabled and your refresh rate is lower than the cap requested, VSync will dominate the setting.
 
	Screen percentage - a technique that can be used both to improve performance or increase the visual quality. Default is 100. The number specifies at what % should the scene be actually rendered within the engine. Afterwards it is scaled to the actual resolution that you set. Choosing 50% with resolution 1920x1080 means that the scene will be rendered at 960x540 and then upscaled. Will look worse, might work better for your configuration, worth checking. If set to 200 in my example, it means that the actual render resolution will be 3840x2160 and then scaled down resulting in much better looks. 400 (maximum) requires very very high end GPU to run at any decent frame. We've decided to add it as a possible optimization, but since the very same variable can improve quality, you can play with it as well. Will work great for very high quality screens ;)
 
	V-Sync - there were issues with this settings, we've fixed those we could find, let us know if it still causes problems. If so, attach dxdiag so we can dig deeper.
 
	Ambient Occlusion - "effect that approximates the attenuation of light due to occlusion." We're noticed that this is one of the effects that causes massive ATI cards performance drops, so here it is for you to try.
 
	Global Illumination - real-time, dynamic indirect lighting technique. This simulates the sun light actually bouncing off surfaces and coming through the opened doors, through windows and so on. In some places the change when disabling this effect will be barely noticeable (outdoors), but huge part of our scene lighting depends on that effect (since you can destroy all the map, the light has to update accordingly). We're allowing you to disable it to improve performance. It is heavy on all configurations, but to a higher degree on ATI/AMD setups.
 
	Film grain - allows you to disable the movie film grain effect on the camera. You requested it, so here you got it.
 
	Chromatic aberration - "effect that simulates the color shifts in real-world camera lenses. The effect is mostly noticeable near the edges of the image." There were several requests to get rid of it, so now you can simply turn it off.
 

 We do realize that solution 'turn off option X if using ATI card' is far from ideal to say the least, but that is what we can do in such a short amount of time. You may switch 1 option off and get FPS boost big enough to play it with no issues. Your choice. We'll keep digging, but can't make any promises whether we find something or not.
 
 If you find some new issues related to these settings do not hesitate to write about it here or contact us. We'll read ;)




Note:
- new settings aren't translated, We will update them in the future.



DC Team

notes.title: Patch nr. 4
notes.notes:
- Fixed some of the reported crashes.
- Previously disabled sound mixers in patch 3 are now enabled.

  We are still investigating what is the problem with the game when the player gets hit by flashbang, has low health or talks after execution
  Updating drivers didn't solve the problem. From the data gathered so far, I can tell that it is somehow related to AMD processors:
  

  AMD A10-5757M APU with Radeon(tm) HD Graphics   (4 CPUs), ~2.5GHz
  AMD Athlon(tm) X4 750K Quad Core Processor      (4 CPUs), ~3.4GHz
  AMD FX(tm)-4100 Quad-Core Processor             (4 CPUs), ~3.6GHz
  AMD FX-8320E Eight-Core Processor               (8 CPUs), ~3.2GHz
  AMD FX(tm)-8350 Eight-Core Processor            (8 CPUs), ~4.0GHz
  AMD FX(tm)-8120 Eight-Core Processor            (8 CPUs), ~3.1GHz
  
  
  And as a temporary workaround We've prepared another command-line switches:
   - DISABLESOUNDMIXERS
   - DISABLEREVERBEFFECT
   

   If You want to use them:
	1) Find Hatred in your the Steam game library
	2) Click RMB and open properties
	3) In the General tab, click on "SET LAUNCH OPTIONS..."
	4) Paste there: -DISABLESOUNDMIXERS -DISABLEREVERBEFFECT
	
	Let us know if this fixes game stuttering during described situations.
	
	

- Adjusted scaling in very high resolutions (21:9) or very low resolutions(640x480) for in game messages (pick-up notification, respawn point notification etc)
- Crouch exploit should be fixed ;)	
   

  
  
DC Team
